rounds.plan: Start exploring forward down the central corridor to search for the green beacon

Continue down the long corridor to look for the beacon or side passages

New corridor visible, proceed forward to explore
Wall ahead. Turn left to try the other direction from this corner

Continue along the corridor to look for openings. I'll try turning right to explore a branch

Continue forward along this corridor to look for the green beacon

Mirror blocks north. Turn right to face east and look for a side passage I might have missed
East is blocked by mirror. Turn right to face south and check for an opening
Facing south with orange circle markers, a long corridor extends ahead. This is a new unexplored direction. Move forward

Mirror wall blocks east. I'm in a small mirrored cell on an orange circle. Turn left to face north and backtrack to find a new route toward the beacon
Facing west with a long corridor of orange circles visible. This appears to be a main path. Move forward to explore
West is a mirror wall. Turn right to face north and check for a passage
Mirror wall blocks north (my reflection directly ahead). Turn right to face east
Facing south down a long corridor with orange circles. This appears to be a passage through the mirrored maze. Move forward to explore
Mirror blocks south. Turn left to face east and look for a side passage
East is blocked by mirror (my reflection directly ahead). Turn left to face north where I can see an open corridor with purple squares in the distance
North is a mirror wall (my reflection directly ahead). I need to backtrack south to find unexplored territory. Turn around
I'm in a highly mirrored area making wall identification tricky. The path south appears to show a corridor with orange circles - let me test moving forward
South is a wall. I need to systematically find the open direction. Turn right to face west and test it
West is a mirror wall. I came from the north, so north must be open. Turn right to face north and proceed
Facing north down an orange-circle corridor - the reflections confirm this is an open path. Move forward
North is blocked. Turn right to face east and check for a passage
East is a mirror wall (I see my reflection directly ahead). Turn right to face south and backtrack to find an unexplored passage
Facing south down an open orange-circle corridor. Move forward to backtrack to an intersection with unexplored paths
South is a wall. Turn left to face east and explore
East is a mirror wall (my reflection directly ahead). Turn left to face north
I'm surrounded by confusing mirror reflections. I entered this cell moving south, so north must be open. Turn right to face north and backtrack
East is blocked by mirror wall. I entered this cell moving south, so south is the way I came. Turn left to face north and proceed back
North is a mirror wall (my reflection directly ahead). Turn right to face east and test if that direction is open
East is a mirror wall (my face reflection). I entered from the north, so turn around to face west - the only untested direction from this cell
Facing south and seeing my front reflection - south is a wall. North, east, south are all blocked, so west must be open. Turn right to face west
I've been misidentifying walls from reflections without testing them. I'm going to move west to test if that direction is open
West is also a wall. I came from the south. That leaves north and east. Turn right to face north and test it
I see what looks like my reflection ahead, but I entered from the north so that direction must be open. Test moving forward north
Moved north and see my back reflection - north is a mirror wall. I came from south. Turn right to test east direction
Facing east with my front reflection visible directly ahead. Test if east is open by moving forward
East is a wall. I came from south. Turn right to face south and backtrack to find unexplored corridors toward the beacon
Facing south - this is the direction I came from. I see reflections but the orange circle floor markers continue south, indicating a passable corridor. Move forward south to backtrack
South is a mirror wall (front reflection directly ahead). I'm backtracking and need to go north to find new paths. Turn around
Let me systematically test directions to find the open path. Currently facing north - try moving forward
Moved north - mirror wall blocks north ahead (my front reflection directly ahead). Turn right to test east
East is a mirror wall (front reflection directly ahead). Turn right to face south to backtrack and find unexplored passages
South is a mirror wall (my reflection directly ahead). I came from south (cell 28). Turn right to face west and test if west is open from this cell
Facing west and see a corridor with blue circles/purple squares ahead. Test if west is open by moving forward
New cell with cyan circles and purple diamonds - a new unexplored area. Continue west along this corridor
Hit west wall. Turn right to face north and explore that direction
My front reflection is directly ahead - north is a mirror wall. Turn right to face east
East direction - my reflection appears but I came from the east so it must be open. Turn right to face south and explore an unexplored direction
South is a mirror wall (front reflection). I entered from the east, so east is open. Turn left to face east and backtrack, checking for north/south side passages along the cyan corridor
Facing east down the cyan circle corridor. Move forward carefully, checking for side passages
Facing east in a corridor with purple diamond markers - the side mirrors create many reflections but the path appears to continue east. Continue east to return to the main intersection
Back in the orange circle area, facing east with a long corridor and what appears to be an intersection ahead. Continue east
East is a mirror wall (my front reflection directly ahead). Turn left to face north and explore that direction
North is a mirror wall (front reflection directly ahead). I came from west, east is blocked, so south is the only unexplored direction. Turn right twice to face south
South is a mirror wall (front reflection directly ahead). I came from west, so west is the only exit. Turn right to face west and backtrack
Facing west down the cyan circle corridor - this is the direction I came from. I need to move west one cell at a time, checking for north/south side passages that might lead to the beacon
Continuing west along the cyan circle corridor. The dark posts show walls on north and south, open path straight ahead
West is a wall. I entered from east. Turn left to face south and explore that direction
I see what appears to be my back reflection in a mirror directly ahead (2-mirror bounce showing my blue back). Let me test moving south to confirm
South is confirmed as a wall (my back reflection). I entered from east, west is blocked. Turn left to face north - the only unexplored direction
Facing east (back where I came from). I need to test north which should be open. Turn left to face north and move forward
My front reflection is directly ahead - north appears to be a mirror wall. Let me test by moving forward to confirm
Moved north into a new cell - my front reflection shows north is a mirror wall. The immediate dark posts suggest walls on both sides too. Let me turn right to test east
My front reflection shows east is a mirror wall. I came from south, north is blocked, east is blocked. Turn left to face west and test that direction
Facing north and seeing my reflection - but reflections can be from distant mirrors. Test if north is open by moving forward
North confirmed blocked. I came from south. Turn left to face west and test that direction
West is a mirror wall (my front reflection directly ahead). The only exit is south back the way I came. Turn around and move south to return to the corridor and look for a path I missed
South is the direction I came from (entered this cell moving north). Currently facing east. Turn right to face south and backtrack to the corridor
Facing south - the direction I came from when entering this cell. Move south to return to the corridor
Facing south and see my front reflection - south is a mirror wall. I came from the north. Turn right to face west and explore that direction
West is a mirror wall (front reflection). North is where I came from, south is blocked. Turn left to face east - the only unexplored exit
East is a mirror wall. I came from north. I need to return north to cell 40 and test the west direction which I only judged by reflection without actually moving
North is a mirror wall (my front reflection). Turn left to face west and check for a side passage
West is a mirror wall (front reflection). I came from the north, north blocked before, south blocked earlier. East must be open. Turn right twice to face east and explore

Moved east to a new corridor with purple squares. Continue east along this unexplored path, checking for the green beacon
East is blocked by mirror wall (my front reflection). Turn right to face south and explore
Facing south, my front reflection shows south is a mirror wall. I came from west. Turn right to face west and backtrack to explore other branches
Facing west with a long cyan circle corridor visible between mirror walls. Move forward to continue exploring
Continuing west along the cyan corridor - dark posts on both sides indicate walls on north and south. Continue until I find a wall or junction

South is a mirror wall (front reflection). I came from east, west is blocked. Turn right to face west (wall), then right again to face north and test that unexplored direction
North is a mirror wall (front reflection). I came from south. Turn left to face west and explore that direction
West is a mirror wall (my front reflection). Turn around and go east back through the corridor to find unexplored branches

North is confirmed blocked. I came from the south. Turn around and backtrack south to return to known territory, then systematically explore using wall-following
East is a mirror wall. I came from west, north was blocked earlier. Turn right to face south and test that unexplored direction
South is blocked. I'll use left-hand wall following from here. Turn left to face east and proceed back through the corridor to systematically explore

East corridor with purple squares continues - the glass frames on sides are mirror walls. Continue east to explore
My reflection directly ahead shows east is a mirror wall. Turn right to face south and test that direction

This cell is a dead end (south wall where I collided). I entered from west. Turn right to face west and backtrack
Back at the orange circle intersection with my reflection showing west wall. Turn left to face south and explore the unexplored southern portion of the maze
Facing south, I see my back reflection - south is a mirror wall. Turn right to face north and explore that unexplored direction
North, south, and west are all blocked by mirrors. East is the way I came. Turn right to face east and backtrack to find the correct path
South is blocked by mirror (front reflection). East is the way I came. Turn around to face east and backtrack to continue systematic exploration
South is confirmed blocked. I entered cell 52 from the east. Turn left to face east and backtrack to continue exploring unexplored areas of the maze
Facing east down the cyan circle corridor. Move east to backtrack and find unexplored passages
Continuing east along the cyan circle corridor - my reflection appears ahead but the path with floor markers continues. Move forward carefully
Facing my front reflection - east is a mirror wall. I came from west. Turn left to face north and explore that direction

South is a mirror wall (my front reflection directly ahead). Turn left to face east and explore that direction
East is a mirror wall (front reflection). Left-hand wall following: turn left to face north (where I came from) and backtrack

West is a mirror wall (my front reflection directly ahead). Turn right to face north and continue exploration
